source_text: Properties of the stack of polarized proper schemes

<STRUCT_0001>
In this section we discuss properties of the moduli stack
<MATH_0001>
whose category of sections over a scheme <MATH_0002> is the category of
proper, flat, finitely presented scheme over <MATH_0003> endowed
with a relatively ample invertible sheaf. This is an algebraic
stack by Quot, Theorem <REF_0001>.

The diagonal of <MATH_0001> is separated
and of finite presentation.
